args.subject: Your UPI payment is being checked
args.body:
Dear Keya Vasa,

We are writing to let you know that your UPI payment is currently being checked by our team. We will update you once the review is complete. No action is needed from you at this time.

Regards,
Customer Support

replies:
I emailed Keya Vasa (C011) at her registered address, keya.vasa39@example.com. The email said her UPI payment is being checked, that we'll update her when the review is done, and that she doesn't need to do anything.

The send returned a message ID (1) and a sent timestamp of 17:03 IST. That confirms the notify service accepted the message. It doesn't confirm the message reached her inbox, and I have no tool that shows delivery or bounce status. So I can't be sure it was delivered.

I haven't re-sent it. The send worked, and the same idempotency key would only return the first send anyway. A second email with a new key would give her a duplicate, and it still wouldn't prove delivery. If you'd like a backup, I can send an SMS to her registered number. You could also ask her to confirm she got the email.
